exceptions.reason: Stable VitePress 1.6.4 requires Vite ^5.4.14; this advisory has no patched Vite 5 release.
exceptions.exploitPreconditions: A network-exposed Vite development server serves sensitive files from a Windows NTFS or 8.3 short-name-enabled volume.
exceptions.absentPreconditions: TerritoryKit CI and release jobs run on Ubuntu and build documentation without starting its dev server. The documentation dev script does not use --host and its VitePress config does not set server.host. Vite 5 is limited to VitePress docs tooling.
exceptions.compensatingControls: Release check rejects changed dependency paths, versions and documentation dev-server exposure. Package tarball checks exclude VitePress and Vite implementation files. No npm package runtime depends on this Vite 5 path.
exceptions.removalCondition: Remove immediately when stable VitePress supports a patched Vite line, a Vite 5 backport appears, docs deployment changes, or Windows/network-exposed docs development is supported.

exceptions.reason: React Native 0.87.x Metro still resolves braces 3.0.3; npm has no braces >=3.0.4 release yet despite the advisory patch range.
exceptions.exploitPreconditions: An attacker supplies deeply nested brace patterns to Metro/micromatch during bundling.
exceptions.absentPreconditions: Published @territory-kit/react-native does not execute Metro on consumer devices at runtime; npm tarballs exclude Metro sources. CI uses Ubuntu without attacker-controlled bundler inputs.
exceptions.compensatingControls: Release hardening blocks undocumented advisories. Package dry-run excludes Metro implementation files from published tarballs. Override shell-quote to 1.11.0 for adjacent react-native toolchain risk.
exceptions.removalCondition: Remove when React Native/Metro pulls braces >=3.0.4 or the advisory is withdrawn.
